From the sea

Photos from the tavern’s own Google listing.

A fish tavern at Limanaki

Isaac Fish Tavern sits at Makariou 77-79 by the small harbour of Ayia Napa, Limanaki, with blue tablecloths and a covered terrace facing the water. In the tavern’s own words: fresh fish every day, great prices and easy parking. On Wednesdays from May to October there is a Cyprus Night with traditional dancing and music.

Open every day from ten in the morning until eleven at night.
